en.title: Wheelchair User Calls for 'Common Sense' After Fine Threat for Using Accessible Zone Without Permit
en.summary: A wheelchair user in Australia is calling for 'common sense' after receiving a fine threat for using an accessible parking zone without a permit. The case highlights the challenges faced by people with disabilities when navigating accessible infrastructure and the need for reasonable accommodations.

zh-TW.title: 輪椅使用者因使用無障礙區域而被罰款威脅 呼籲「common sense」
zh-TW.summary: 澳洲一名輪椅使用者因在無障礙停車區使用時未持有許可證而收到罰款威脅，呼籲「common sense」。此案例凸顯了殘疾人士在使用無障礙設施時面臨的挑戰，以及對合理便利的需求。
